title: SISO Fading Channel
text: 通过 SISO 多径衰落信道对输入信号进行滤波，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；按 {Channel visualization} 指定信道可视化；{Inherit sample rate from input} 用于从输入继承采样率、{Sample rate (Hz)} 指定输入信号采样率、{Discrete path delays (s)} 指定每个离散路径的延迟、{Average path gains (dB)} 指定每个离散路径的平均增益、{Normalize average path gains to 0 dB} 用于将平均路径增益归一化为 0 dB、{Fading distribution} 指定信道的衰落分布、{K-factors} 指定 Rician 衰落信道的 K 因子、{LOS path Doppler shifts (Hz)} 指定视距分量的多普勒频移、{LOS path initial phases (rad)} 指定视距分量的初始相位、{Maximum Doppler shift (Hz)} 指定所有信道路径的最大多普勒频移、{Doppler spectrum} 指定所有信道路径的多普勒频谱形状 doppler、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器初始种子、{Output channel path gains} 用于输出信道路径增益、{Output channel filter delay} 输出信道滤波器延迟、{Simulate using} 指定编译类型 Interpreted、{Percentage of samples to display} 指定要显示的样本百分比、{Path for Doppler spectrum display} 显示 Doppler 频谱的路径，按实例取值。

ports.name: Out1
ports.summary: 衰落信道的输出数据信号 vector

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: 用于从输入继承采样率的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输入信号采样率 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Discrete path delays (s)
params.values: 每个离散路径的延迟 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | row vector

params.name: Average path gains (dB)
params.values: 每个离散路径的平均增益 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Normalize average path gains to 0 dB
params.values: 用于将平均路径增益归一化为 0 dB 的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Fading distribution
params.values: 信道的衰落分布 Rayleigh (default) | Rician

params.name: K-factors
params.values: Rician 衰落信道的 K 因子 3 (default) | positive scalar | row vector of nonnegative values

params.name: LOS path Doppler shifts (Hz)
params.values: 视距分量的多普勒频移 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: LOS path initial phases (rad)
params.values: 视距分量的初始相位 0 (default) | scalar | row vector

params.name: Maximum Doppler shift (Hz)
params.values: 所有信道路径的最大多普勒频移 0.001 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Doppler spectrum
params.values: 所有信道路径的多普勒频谱形状 doppler(’Jakes’) (default) | doppler(’Flat’) | doppler(’Rounded’,...) | doppler(’Bell’,...) | doppler(’Asymmetric Jakes’,...) | doppler(’Restricted Jakes’,...) | doppler(’Gaussian’,...) | doppler(’BiGaussian’,...)

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: 随机数生成器初始种子 73 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Output channel path gains
params.values: 用于输出信道路径增益的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Output channel filter delay
params.values: 输出信道滤波器延迟的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 编译类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Channel visualization
params.values: 选择信道可视化 Off (default) | Impulse response | Frequency response | Doppler spectrum | Impulse and frequency responses

params.name: Path for Doppler spectrum display
params.values: 显示 Doppler 频谱的路径 1 (default) | positive integer
